target: local Mac / bounded Codex or Hermes read-analysis cycle

authority.codex: READ private ingest reports and candidate local files; prepare one bounded review packet. Canonical/public writes only if separately allowlisted by the task result.
authority.hermes: READ / HASH / ANALYZE / PREPARE_PACKET only; no canonical writes by default.

sources.requirement: Locate by known local backup tooling/provenance; do not infer original names from ordinal export filenames.

preflight: git fetch --prune origin if operating inside a repo; report branch/dirty/HEAD/origin divergence before any write.
Locate each private report and verify its SHA-256 before analysis. If any required report is missing or hash-mismatched, RETURN BLOCKED and stop.
Confirm the source tree remains read-only for this task; output must live outside the scanned source tree.
Resolve /control/POLICY_INDEX.json plus /control/HERMES_LONG_GOALS.json when Hermes is used.
objective: Review exactly ONE candidate family containing at least one runnable/source artifact and one authored design/specification document, using content-hash + original-name/source provenance. Determine their relationship without moving, deleting, renaming, publishing or semantically merging source files.
selection_law: Prefer a family with exact provenance linkage and a plausible current/recovered lineage recipient.
Do not choose a family merely because it is visually interesting.
Do not reopen City/Painting, Path/Grid or other already-resolved families unless the private evidence reveals a concrete contradiction.
procedure: Join candidate records to the original provenance manifest by content hash.
Inspect only enough candidate content to identify executable/source role and authored design/spec role.
Record exact hashes, original names, dates/source anchors where available, and duplicate state.
Classify the relationship using one relation_class; preserve contradictions.
Compare against CURRENT/MIGRATION/CENSUS only to identify an existing recipient or donor shelf; do not create a new project name.
Prepare one candidate packet. Do not perform filesystem mutation or public publication.

output.privacy: Do not paste private document contents, raw paths, chat metadata or personal filenames into public repo output. A private/local packet may retain local paths if needed.

gates.machine: All cited hashes resolve to the verified local ingest/provenance sources; no source mutation; no duplicate identity inferred beyond bytes.
gates.semantic: The relationship claim is supported by exact provenance/content inspection, not filename/title similarity.
gates.promotion: Any repo copy/publication is a separate bounded action with explicit allowlist and RETURN.

stop: On ambiguous provenance that cannot distinguish version/association/duplicate.
expected_return: One evidence-bearing semantic family packet or an explicit BLOCKED/NO_GAIN receipt.
